desc: Ideation: identify per-element insertion-sort formula as the leading candidate.
Implement final O(N log N) solution (Fenwick over values, fast stdin/stdout).
Exhaustive brute-force validation for all permutations N≤7 via Dijkstra: no counterexamples, formula confirmed.
Formula justification: leftward-insertion achieves exactly I_v*pos_v − I_v(I_v+1)/2 per value with INV swaps (minimum), and exhaustive search up to N=7 shows no cheaper schedule exists.
